headline: Mercedes told Russell to back off on his final Q3 lap in Brazil
body: Russell was told to lift midway through his last push lap as rain returned and Albon's Williams was ahead on track. He qualified second behind Norris and radioed that he wanted P1. Wolff called it a 50:50 decision and said Russell was 18 milliseconds up on Norris at that point.

headline: Alonso gives Aston Martin its first Q3 of the season in Brazil
body: Alonso qualified ninth in the wet and will start eighth after Leclerc's penalty. He said points are possible only if the race stays wet, and that Aston Martin expects to return to its natural position in the dry.
